'''Voryam Bhao''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He is described as having a honey-[[Color/Legends|colored]] complexion, curly black hair, and a "sneering upper lip just begging to be ripped off his face." Bhao was killed by a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] raiding party on [[Nickel One]], along with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Krom Rethway]], among others, during the [[Second Battle of Roche]].<ref name="Invincible" />
